race.comment: STREET ARTIST (4) hasn't won for a while but recent signs are good. Came from a long way back to get up for third last start 1100m at this track. New to this trip but gives every indication of running it out. REGAL PROBLEM (5) opened this prep with back-to-back wins then laboured into fourth under 61kgs over this distance at Rosehill last time. Drops 2kgs today and the engagement of Nash is a tick. SCILLATO (3) finally hit form seven days ago at the fourth run back from a spell, closing strongly to just miss at the end of 1200m at Rosehill. Should prove tough to stop over the extra 100m this afternoon. YOURE NOT THE KING (6) returned in fine order at Hawkesbury last time and at just his fifth start has great scope for improvement. Sparingly raced mare BENEATH THE ROCK (8) dominated first-up at Newcastle. Scored easily here at this trip second-up last prep so her profile is strong.
